title: CLI tests read the wire through the bridge's own reader, one harness
deviations_from_card: Shrunk nothing, grew nothing: exactly the card's 9-file write set. Commit types are all `test(...)` (the commit-msg gate refuses `refactor` for a test-only commit). CliRun carries one field the card did not name, raw_envelope (the object the CLI itself wrote on its last stderr line), because through the bridge reader every envelope HAS a derived code - group_compare's 'the envelope carries a code at all' and winnability's vocabulary check would otherwise go vacuous; both now read raw_envelope. argv files are referenced as '@<name>' placeholders. On a non-zero exit payload is None and on exit 0 envelope is None (the bridge reads exactly one). Premise line numbers re-located per the critic (matrix _run :51-70 + inline :165-184/:206-224; winnability :262-273/:319-327/:363-374) - counts were exact.
notes: Acceptance 8/8: (1) trailing ResourceWarning -> payload {'a':1} via run_cli over a fake CLI; (2) '42' and '' -> BridgeReadError, and run_cli over a silent exit-0 CLI raises; (3) last-line coded envelope; (4) 404-no-code / blank code / plain text exit 2 and exit 1 derivations; (5) 35-row case table (15 stdout, 20 stderr) green through BOTH the real parsePythonJson/parseStderrError (36 TS tests) and the port; mutation check ({} treated falsy + str.strip for JS trim) turns the Python table red on its row; (6) reasoning_cli missing job now asserts envelope 404/not_found AND raw_envelope code not_found; (7) run_cli raises BridgeReadError naming a code outside _cli.ERROR_CODES by default (check_codes=False opt-out, pinned); (8) redirect/redirect/TemporaryDirectory grep over the five files 28 -> 1 (the agent-fit ledger tempdir that must outlive the run). The five suites keep all 60 tests/assertions (72 with the new module). Red-before: test_bridge_reader.py failed on import (all reader/harness cases); the TS half passed on write since it pins existing TS behaviour (that is its job - it is the oracle's anchor). python-runner.ts NOT edited; the TS test imports only parsePythonJson/parseStderrError, and llm-inference-runtime/B's concurrent edits did not break the import. Gates: npm run test:python:gate 0 (3038 tests, 4 tolerated skips, baseline untouched), lint:ruff-ratchet 0, test:eval:ci 0, eslint 0, docs:check 0, lint:ts-ratchet 0. FOREIGN reds, none on my paths: tsc/typecheck red first on sibling in-flight app/_lib/analyze-run.test.ts, app/api/extract-text/route.test.ts, app/api/match/engine-busy.test.ts (llm-inference-runtime/B), after ~60s+ only on the untracked kpi-sim/runs/**/main-tree copy; test:unit 10755/10756 with the one BROKEN being app/features/tools/devcases/outboxView.test.ts (sibling's uncommitted OutboxRows.tsx); test:perf red on app/api/agents/hire-from-need/route.ts 3183 KB vs 3169 KB ceiling - my commits touch only test files and Python, which are in no route graph. npm run typecheck rewrote contract-constants.generated.ts line endings only -> restored. Doc-sync: internal-only trailers (test harness, no product behaviour). loop_open: none - the rule opened (vocabulary check at read time) now defaults on for all five suites; the other ~30 suite files that redirect stdio can migrate to run_cli later.
